author: ValWood
body:
Hi, as this is a human annotation from MGI, I don't think I can query in protein2GO?

UniProtKB:Q9UIC8 | LCMT1 | acts_upstream_of_or_within | GO:0090266    regulation of mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint | ECO:0000315   IMP | PMID:17724024 |   | 9606 Homo sapiens

essentially this is a very loose inference , a role in spindle checkpoint is suggested, but not shown. The prolonged arrest doesn’t fit a defective checkpoint, a weak spindle checkpoint usually means cells can’t hold an arrest
this seems more like an unsatisfied checkpoint.

I would remove this, and at the same time, the annotations to 
GO:0006479    protein methylation (pending obsoletion)
GO:0006481    C-terminal protein methylation (pending obsoletion)
GO:0042981 regulation of apoptotic process (readout, cells that can not complete mitosis go into apoptosis but this is a consequence of the mutation ,  LCMT1 it isn't involved in the process itself.

This should also block 
GO:0090266    regulation of mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint | ECO:0000318   IBA | GO_REF:0000033 | PANTHER:PTN001006316
soone althoughh @marcfeuermann  you could remove it.

@LiNiMGI  it is OK for this not to have a BP annotation, since we dont really know what it is doing  (its in our conserved unknowns and I am assessing predictions, of  which this is one). The re are functional clues here but nothing annotatable.
v
